brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@buildthis.bisks.net mind checking this error?

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@danny.page: @bisks.net 1) hello to a fellow Caps fan!
2) I like this app, wanted to note a bug that the links to the profiles seem to not be escaping the colon in the DID correctly (Mac OS, Chrome) 
sixdegreesofseperation.bisks.net
  [image, alt text: Oops!
Unable to fulfill XRPC request

Try again]

[from the harness, not the requester] 1 image from this thread is attached to this build as a file — you can see it. If someone asks whether you can see their screenshot, the answer is yes.

[from the harness, not the requester] These images were in the thread but could
NOT be downloaded, so you do NOT have them. Don't describe or guess at their
contents. If they matter to the request, say in your reply that you couldn't
fetch them and ask for a description.
- https://cdn.bsky.app/img/feed_fullsize/plain/did:plc:5tlwm4ujvnudrzndqubefgiu/bafkreifcf7trmzyz32v6cm2llq2bqhbcrngf4xg7hsoiqknqse5c7z43fm (came back as , not an image)
note: Fixed it: profile links were percent-encoding the colons in the DID, which bsky.app can't parse. They use the plain DID now. Thanks @danny.page! #NaNoFoMo
